protocol.online_updates: GRU hidden state only, using current observation and past command/residual
protocol.future_inputs: preplanned nominal commands, known at forecast origin
protocol.rollout: freeze eight-dimensional latent at origin; do not read future RGB/observations
protocol.targets: noisy observed for training; simulator truth only for held-out scoring
protocol.metrics: pooled body v RMSE in m/s and yaw-rate RMSE in rad/s, reported separately
protocol.reset_history: same fusion weights; hidden reset each origin; retain current causal q/u_previous/residual
protocol.shuffle_image: same fusion weights; unrelated image drawn from fixed TRAIN-only RGB pool, no future held-out image
protocol.latent_semantics: learned predictive context; no calibrated physical/friction meaning
protocol.statistics_warning: overlapping horizons are correlated; episode is the repetition unit
